name: adapty
description: Official Adapty plugins — subscriptions, paywalls and app marketing, run by your agent.

plugins.name: adapty-skills
plugins.description: Skills that hand your app's subscription surface to your agent: integrate the Adapty SDK on any mobile platform (iOS, Android, Flutter, React Native, Unity, KMP, Capacitor), get the first sandbox purchase through, build and edit Flow Builder paywalls and onboardings, audit a flow before you publish, move paywall placements to flows, run Apple Search Ads, read which campaigns pay back in Adapty Attribution, turn a paywall or onboarding into ranked conversion tests, and answer a product, dashboard or API question straight from Adapty's docs.

plugins.name: adapty-sdk-integration
plugins.description: Deprecated alias for adapty-skills — same plugin, same skills. Install adapty-skills@adapty instead; this entry exists so earlier installs keep resolving and will be removed in a future release.

plugins.name: apple-ads
plugins.description: Put your Apple Ads budget where it actually returns: cohort bid reviews, Market Intelligence keyword opportunities, search-term harvesting, negatives, CPP routing, and read-only account diagnostics through the Adapty CLI.

plugins.name: apple-ads-benchmarks
plugins.description: Know whether your Apple Ads numbers are any good: TTR, CR, CPT and CPA benchmarks by country, App Store genre and niche, plus subscriber economics and relative effect studies for subscription apps.
